verdict.rationale: The Cactus GitHub README shows a first-party CLI flow (`brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus` then `cactus run`), which suggests launching a model from the terminal. However, nothing explicitly says `cactus run` opens an interactive, multi-turn chat session. The only chat evidence is an Android app, which is not a terminal experience. missing for 10: explicit documentation that `cactus run` provides an interactive chat REPL, details on model selection and session behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of terminal chat
